thesis: This episode offers a retrospective look at the evolution of major delivery and mobility platforms, specifically Uber and DoorDash, acknowledging their past challenges and current market positions. The speaker contrasts these companies with competitors like Waymo and Tesla, framing the narrative around survival, growth, and the shifting landscape of industrial AI and logistics.
